errors.evidence: In the figure, the larger blue sector (66.7%) occupies the right and bottom portion of the pie, while the smaller orange sector (33.3%) is at the top-left. The description's characterization of positioning is imprecise — the blue sector spans both left and right sides substantially, and the orange sector is at the upper portion. However, strictly speaking, the larger sector does occupy more of the right side, so this is a minor inaccuracy in spatial description.

The description states the blue sector 'is visually larger' which is an interpretive comparison. The generation prompt explicitly states not to compare values unless the chart itself implies such a comparison. While the percentages do show a difference, adding the evaluative phrase 'visually larger' goes beyond neutral description of the labeled values.
